messages:
ralph: Heads-up from a customer on react-native mobile-sdk: after an auth-refresh reconnect we see duplicated partial tokens and out-of-order fragments in the UI.
ralph: Flaky repro: start a long streaming gen on mobile -> force an auth refresh (short TCP close ~120ms) -> client reconnects with resume token -> UI shows duplicated 'ing' fragments interleaved.
r alf: sorry typo above, meant ralph.
nina: Which resume mechanism does mobile use? Last-Event-ID or resume param/header?
ralph: mobile-sdk v0.2.4 sends resume_token as a header (X-Resume-Token). We also include small client-side queue for fragments.
vlad: Can you paste the wire-level SSE frames? Need to check event ids and ordering boundaries.
ralph: Wire extract (tcpdump -> trimmed):
```
: ping
event: message
id: 711 data:{seq:711,part:1,text:Hel}

connection: reset

: ping
event: message
id:712 data:{seq:712,part:1,text:lo }
event: message
id:711 data:{seq:711,part:2,text:lo}
```
ralph: Client ended up rendering: "Hel lo lo" -> duplicate "lo" and wrong interleaving.

nina: Looks like the proxy/runtime replayed seq 711 part2 after seq 712 started. We had an optimization to async-flush buffered tail fragments on disconnect (perf reg).
vlad: That matches. The proxy has an outgoing buffer that now flushes independent of the resume replay path, so replayed fragments can intermix with freshly generated ones.
proxy-bot: ticket PROXY-2031 created for investigate: async flush + resume interleave.

mobile-ci: Quick mitigation idea: add an ordering layer in mobile-sdk that groups by (seq,part) and waits for missing parts for a short window before emitting to UI. That minimizes visible duplication and is low risk.
qa-ian: We should be careful with timeouts — mobile networks have higher jitter. Maybe make wait window configurable and shorter for low-latency apps.
nina: Agreed. We'll add an opt-in buffering-on-resume flag to SDKs. Also propose adding an explicit X-Chunk-Seq and X-Chunk-Part header in the runtime so clients don't need to parse body fields for ordering.
vlad: Runtime side: we can add a feature-flagged behavior: drain outgoing buffer before serving resume replays, and start tagging fragments with X-Chunk-Seq/X-Chunk-Part. Will coordinate rollout so SDKs can read header first.
ralph: I'll open a small mobile-sdk PR to buffer+sort by headers when resume detected. Will include a flaky emulation test that simulates TCP flaps and variable delivery ordering.
mobile-ci: Please include a deterministic flappy-proxy harness so tests are reproducible in CI.
proxy-bot: PROXY-2031 assigned to vlad. Added note: consider Last-Event-ID compatibility for browsers.
nina: Good call. We'll document the expected behavior in docs/streaming-reconnects.md and include guidance on tuning the mobile buffer/timeouts.
ralph: PR: https://git.internal/r/mobile-sdk/77 (buffer-on-resume + test). Deploying canary shortly. Will report back with canary results. :thumbsup:
